name: Partial-Trace Path and Star Calibrations
definition: Apply the full partial-trace expansion first to the singleton $C=\{0\}\subseteq\{0,1\}$, and then to the rank-one maximum three-coordinate star $S=\{000,100,010,001\}$.
properties: The singleton expands to the three-word maximum path $\{(0,0),(0,1),(1,1)\}$ of rank one. The star expands to a 54-word ample class on six coordinates with VC dimension four; it is not itself maximum because the rank-four Sauer bound there is 57. It nevertheless has a maximum parent of the exact shifted minimum rank.
